Container.Name: BudMinder
Container.Overview:
A self-hosted cannabis grow journal for home growers. Keep daily notes, measurements and photos for every plant from seed to harvest, see live temperature, humidity, VPD and CO2 from AC Infinity, Ecowitt or Home Assistant sensors, and track your strains and seed vault. Everything stays on your server: SQLite by default (PostgreSQL optional), with backups you can download and restore in Settings.
The first time you open it, BudMinder asks you to create your account: choose your own username and password.
Your database lives in the Data folder and your photos in the Uploads folder; both survive container updates. Based on Isley by dwot.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: grow journal growlog grow log plants garden cannabis seeds strains ac infinity ecowitt home assistant vpd isley

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the BudMinder web page. Pick any free port on your server; 8091 is suggested because 8080 is often already taken.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, settings, backups and BudMinder's key file.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in the Data and Uploads folders. 99 (nobody) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in the Data and Uploads folders. 100 (users) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: Database type
Config.Description: sqlite (built in, nothing to set up) or postgres (fill in the PostgreSQL settings below).

Config.Name: PostgreSQL host
Config.Description: Only for postgres: the PostgreSQL server's address.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL database
Config.Description: Only for postgres: the database name.
